label: Giving being at a moment: a primitive time-indexed exercise of causation of a thing's being
definition: BeingGiving.GivesAt v c x t: in history v, c exercises causation of x's being at moment t. Explicitly identified PRIMITIVE relation; no axiom constrains it. The time index is the effect side, the moment at which the activity bears on x; it does not say that the agent is in time (ST I q.104 a.1 ad 4 calls the divine conserving action 'without either motion or time'). Ordinary meaning: the sun is giving the air its light at noon. Two readings; the theorems hold for any interpretation. STRICT: esse-giving, the time-indexed counterpart of CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_3 (CausesIn c x esse), used by the sustaining sense and the immensity route. INCLUSIVE: also causing a thing's coming to be (CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_1, CausesOrigin), as a builder causes a house in its becoming though not directly its being (q.104 a.1 co.); the originating sense is stated for both. Self-giving (GivesAt v x x t) is not excluded by the type; the intended reading is a cause distinct from its effect, and that restriction is not typed. Distinguished from counterfactual dependence (x would not be at t without it), from removing or preventing a destroyer (q.104 a.1 ad 3), from the world-level Ontic.Causes, and from the tenseless CausesIn c x esse (DEF-CAUSE-OF-PERFECTION), to which it is related only by explicit open bridges.
note: Analyst primitive, attribution deferred. It is the shared carrier of the two senses of CAUSE_OF_BEING (disambiguation 88a8fba7): originating and sustaining causation of being differ only in the moments at which GivesAt is required. Structural properties: none built in (not transitive, asymmetric, irreflexive or functional; several givers of one thing are allowed). OPEN formal content, inherited from the per se conservation definition 56989bd0: an analysis of the exercise as productive receipt of this same bearer's esse, and of the dependence that 'required at every moment' adds to mere concurrence. Would be sourced by a reading that types esse-giving activity, not by any passage already pinned.
